retrieval_skill.name: regime_aware_signal_retrieval
retrieval_skill.description: Separate observed telemetry from operational artifacts and the underlying process by identifying regime changes, validating how shutdowns or suspensions are encoded, and extracting persistent baseline and cyclical trends.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When forecasting a time series whose history may contain maintenance windows, outages, policy changes, or other interventions that alter the meaning of recorded values.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search for documentation and evidence about the forecast window, operational schedules, telemetry behavior during interruptions, recent regime changes, and multi-cycle baseline and peak trends; organize findings into observation, regime, and latent-process layers.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Treat an apparent value as process evidence only when its measurement semantics and provenance are established; confirm regime changes apply within the forecast window and support trend claims with repeated observations across multiple cycles.
